newsitem.title: USA: Superior Services files for 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Superior Services files for 5 mln shares.

text.p: Superior Services Inc said it filed a shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to register five million shares of common stock.
The shares registered may be offered by the company and sold to the public from time to time as determined by market conditions and other factors.

Superior said the shelf registration will allow the company to raise equity capital quickly and take advantage of favorable market conditions as it pursues its growth strategy of acquiring additional solid waste businesses.
Superior Services is a solid waste services company.
